build_ngrams_decontamination_index: build an n-gram decontamination index from lighteval tasks or input documents using NGramsDecontIndexer
create_ngrams_decontamination_config: create an NGramsDecontConfig with custom n_grams size, query matching, and overlap detection settings
compute_ngram_hashes: compute hashed n-grams from label and optional query text for decontamination index building
filter_contaminated_documents: filter documents by checking their n-grams against a decontamination index and removing contaminated ones
load_decontamination_index_hashes: load precomputed n-gram hash index files from a data folder for document decontamination filtering
